title: Solar SCADA Software: ETi-SOL | EnerMAN Technologies
description: ETi-SOL is cloud solar SCADA software for rooftop, C&I and utility PV: real-time monitoring, control and alerts, multi-site view, web and mobile apps.
heading: ETi-SOL: monitor, control and analyse every solar plant you own, from one login.

blocks.text: ETi-SOL: monitor, control and analyse every solar plant you own, from one login.
Cloud-hosted SCADA for rooftop, C&I and utility-scale PV. Web dashboard for analysis, Android and iOS apps for status and alerts.

blocks.alt: ETi-SOL home screen: fleet capacity, energy and eco savings above the plant list, with each plant's status, energy, yield, CUF and PR

blocks.text: Real-time data acquisition, monitoring and control of every inverter, meter and sensor on the plant
ETi-SOL collects plant data through ETi-LOG or your existing SCADA. Its alerts, analytics and reports help you prevent generation loss and improve plant performance.
One dashboard across all plants, with the live status of all the equipment of plants in different geographies.

blocks.text: Monitor your PV plant in a single frame view, with components status and live data.
Uses the existing hardware of a non-functional SCADA in the plant, and monitors remotely and locally.
No need of high-speed internet lease lines. Data is pushed to the SCADA server over a 2G connection.
Data export to external aggregators, and data exchange over FTP, OPC, API and MQTT.
Hand over a plant with monitoring already live, and keep O&M visibility after handover.
One portfolio view across plants, states and vendors, with the numbers a lender or buyer asks for.
Know today’s generation and yesterday’s faults without walking to the inverter room.
Web dashboard for analysis, Android and iOS apps for status and alerts.

blocks.alt: ETi-SOL dashboard on a laptop, desktop monitor, tablet and phone

blocks.text: What it monitors, what it needs on site, what it reports. Full manual on request.
IoT datalogger that feeds ETi-SOL from the plant
The same SCADA on your own server
Active and reactive power, power factor and ramp rate control
Bring your solar plants to one screen.
For IPPs, EPCs, utilities, rooftop owners, agri-solar and O&M providers.
